The lights did not appear to strobe, as would an airplane, and they did not seem to be just at the three points of the triangle, but rather all along the three sides. The object had a strange appearance to it, if you saw the movie Predator with Arnold Schwarzenegger, the object seemed to have the same shimmer as the alien did in the movie. The object appeared to travel in a straight line, not moving around or at different speeds. There is an US Air Force Base 30 some odd miles south west of my home, Vance Air Force Base.

Two military jets were seen at an estimated 30,000 feet above the objects heading in the same direction, but it was unclear if the jets were aware of the object's presence.
The last objects to be seen were small white dots that were spotted flying irregularly at a quick speed. They were much higher than the average commercial aircraft.
The sightings ended just after 17:30 PM, three separate types of UFOs witnessed.

I noticed a dim light in the sky to the east-northeast, moving a bit fast. I thought it was a meteorite, but as I watched, it seemed to change course and “fly” horizontally. 
As the light approached, it appeared to have a definitive shape, sort of like a wedge or boomerang. The entire object seemed to glow with a faint reddish-orange light, and there appeared to be rows of slightly brighter lights underneath it. 
From my perspective, it would have been approximately half an inch wide. I heard no engine or wind noise. 
The object passed overhead and continued on a straight path toward the west-southwest. From the moment I first spotted it to the moment it disappeared from sight, about eight seconds passed.

summary: An alternating red and blue lighted object, bobbling rapidly and erratically in the sky and then descending  in a controlled fashion.
description: We saw a red object in the sky, that started as a smooth arc to the east. Then the object began to bobble, shifting positions quickly and erratically, left to right, up and down. At one point the light turned to blue and then changed back to red. Colors changed intermittently from red to blue several times. Then it displayed both red and blue and slowly and controllably descended out of the field of view in a straight line. The lighted object was much larger than traditional airplane lights, approximately 1/8th the size of the moon last night.

summary: On 10/13/10, while driving, I saw an unusual nonblinking, stationary light over Cincinnati.
description: On Wednesday, October 13, 2010, after 8p.m. in the sky over Cincinnati, Ohio, there was a single white steady light. It did not seem to move, but I was driving at the time and could not keep my eyes on the object. It was quite bigger than any visible stars or planets, but a very small fraction of the size of the moon.

summary: Flashing light circles over Lincoln CA for at least an hour
description:
My wife and I where sitting on our balcony a few minutes before 8:00 pm PST when a small flashing object object caught my peripheral vision. Normally this would be of no concern or significance as we live in an area less than 2 miles from our municipal airport and between Beal AFB and Sac IAP, but the strobe of the light was a bit odd, a white light strobing at a pace of slightly slower than 1 sec per flash. 
I casually followed the path of the object as it traveled south east then made a long turn that eventually became a large counter-clockwise circle several miles in diameter. Once again this would not be unusual as planes often circle around waiting for an open runway to land on, but the arc took a long time to complete and the object was at an abnormally high altitude for a plane waiting to land. 
I brought this to the attention of my wife then called my two daughters and my mother in law to observe and see if they found it odd. As we watched the object continued to circle around at the same altitude and speed with each lap taking approximately 10 minutes. 
On one lap the object passed directly overhead and we could see that it was two distinct lights of the same size one in…

summary: Multiple UFO sighting in NYC
description:
From the roof of my building, I could see a pulsating light hovering in a westerly direction. The lights were white, green and red.
Then I saw a pulsating light to the south. It too pulsated the same colors.
These two pulsating orbs remained hovering together.
About 25 minutes later, I seen a pulsating light to the north.
The lights were blue, green and purple.
Now the three pulsating orbs are hovering together.
Half hour later, there is a pulsating light to the east. Same colors as the previously mentioned.
This time the last two pulsating orbs are hovering together.
The first two have gone.
We suspect that the objects may have been twinkling stars. PD

summary: Black V-shaped UFO with 5 orange lights
description:
About 20 minutes before sundown while on the phone I noticed an aircraft which was thin, black and shaped like a V.
I got a very good daytime look at it. Ill never forget it.
It had 5 glowing (not shiny)orange lights underneath.
(lights 2 ft. diameter) As it passed overhead (NW to SE), I didn't hear much except for a very quiet humming sound. It was flying low (app. 200 ft.) and slow (app. 100 mph).
The wingspan was around 40 to 50 ft.
It wasn't a B2-stealth bomber.
There was no cockpit, fuselage, rudders, or engines. Just a V.
Seemed to be floating, or gliding.
My best guess is that it is an undercover drone or surveillance plane.
I need help identifying this aircraft.
I never thought I'd see a UFO until i saw this.
My report is documented with MUFON case #25885. The only discrepancy in my account is the wingspan of the aircraft. i said 200 feet, but it was more around 40 feet.

summary: Strange gray object spotted in my small town
description:
I was heading home from work on Wednesday, October 13th, 2010, on what was earlier, a rainy day. When the evening came around, the sky was beautifully clear and blue. I was driving, 10 and 2, and looked over my left shoulder. I was heading West bound. I saw something in the sky and passed it off at first. I took another look over and it was still there. I continued to observe it for roughly a minute. It was stationary and I was just WAITING for it to move. Since it wasn't moving I figured I would get my cell phone out of my pocket and video it. I turned my head toward the road to concentrate on driving, pulled out my cell phone, turned on the camera, and the object was gone. It was shaped sort of like a cross. The center was more of a thin oval. There was a small protrusion on the top of the object and a protrusion on the bottom that was about twice as long as the one on top. It was VERY low to the ground. Probably about 200 yards from me, and 80! -100 feet in the air. There is little to no air traffic in this small town. We have a couple of bright yellow crop dusters, and they're hard to mistake.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Bright yellow and white glowing sphere motionless for 7-10 minutes, changes shape, disapears
description:
Yesterday at around 5:00pm I noticed what looked like a large round object in the sky directly above with the slightest Northwesterly angle when pointing at it. I was lying on my back outside looking skyward when I noticed the round object that appeared to glow a bright yellow and white color. It did not move at all. I showed my wife and 3.5 year old daughter and both saw the object. After watching it for about 7-10 minutes it appeared to get larger in one instant and then about 10 seconds later it disappeared.
While looking at it we speculated that it might be a balloon but concluded it was too large. We then wondered if it was a star shining very brightly but we have never seen a star glow so much in the day... it was not a star.
I was not going to tell anyone about what we witnessed until by chance I saw photos accompanying a story on AOL.com today of almost the exact same thing yesterday over New York!!!!!!!!!! The moment I saw the photos I had a rush of adrenaline and a became a little spooked because of the extreme similarity to our experience yesterday. My wife had nightmares all night...
Me - 42yrs old business owner Wife - 40yrs old designer Child - 3.5yrs old

summary: Vertical cigar shaped object in western horizon sited, then disappears...
description:
While driving west, sun beginning to set and very clear skies, I viewed along with usual planes in areas, a vertical cigar shaped very very bright object in the sky, far west and up from Naperville,Illinois...each time I was able to stop, I had placed it going due west so that I could tell if there was any movement, turning, change of pattern or changing to horizontal position...none of these happened.
I made one jogging turn, and in possibly less than l/4 of a minute, the object was completely out of the sky in any of that area.
The sky again, had no cloud formations, was clear blue, and bright sun...there was no where it could have flown to that quickly...what struck me was how bright it was, and the vertical shape, and fact that Im certain, it hovered, and did not fly....

summary: I captured an unknown metallic flying object on my digital camera photo.
description:
My husband and I were in our back yard taking photos of the sky. We had a number of twin rotor helicopters fly over our home, about 6-7 times in an hour so we were just outside watching. The last helicopter flew over at approximately 15:01 according to the time stamp on the cell phone video I took of it. It was a nice day so we decided to stay outside in the yard. We are near CAK and so there is a lot of jet traffic in our area all the time and we are used to it...however on this day there was much more air traffic than normal. My husband noted that some of the jets were moving unusually fast and although they should have been in ear shot, were making no noise that we could hear from the ground. I began snapping photos of those jets and their contrails.
Upon review of the photos on my digital camera I noticed a dark spot in one of them. Thinking it was just a piece of dirt on the LCD screen I scrolled to the next photo, and when I did the spot disappeared. I went back to the previous photo and the spot was there again, at this time I took the memory card out and put it in my lap top so that I could zoom in. I fully expected the spot to be a bird or falling leaf, however it was…

description:

We sat down and I gazed up into the sky as it's been quite a long day. While looking up, I noticed three VERY high objects in the sky. Too high to be planes or helicopters. At first my colleagues thought they were planes but then I pointed out the fact that for starters, they were in a triangular formation and NOT moving. So now my colleagues and I are all observing these objects in a triangle and they appeared to be glowing white. When I put on my brown, polarized sunglasses, it…

summary: Orange light seen hovering and moving over Rochester
description:
On the night of 13 October 2010 I was on my overnight watch for the fire department in my local town. I stepped outside in the early morning for a smoke break and to look at the sky since it was so clear out. I walked around the firehouse to check and make sure everything was locked up and nothing was out of the ordinary. As I turned the South West corner of the building I noticed a bright light approximately 10 miles away directly west of the firehouse.
I watched this light for approximately 15 minutes trying to figure out what it belonged to. I was figuring a helicopter until I compared the object with a stationary object close to me. That is when I noticed the object was moving from left to right approximately 2-3 miles at a time in less than a minute. The object continued doing this with-out ever dimming, so I was able to dismiss the bright light as being a landing light on the front of an aircraft. Since the landing light would dim as the aircraft turned away from me if it was circling something.
After 45 minutes of watching this light moving left to right and occasionally up and down I noticed the light seem to be moving away from me, West. With-in 3 minutes the light had…

summary: A string of about  12 amber lights sighted in clear late evening sky moving NNE from the Smoky Mnts.
description: A string of amber lights appeared to rise from SSE. I first thought they were aircraft following each other towards TYS air field. I called my wife and quickly got my binoculars after about 6 bright amber lights appeared in a straight line. I tried to focus on each individual head lamp to get it into focus but I couldnt get a sharp image of an aircraft head lamp on none of the lights. They seemed to have gained altitude about 30 miles downrange, rise and get closer to the air field in an unusual single file path. Their were about 12 amber lights. I checked the objects for aircraft navigation lights, red, green, white flashing lights but there were none. I commonly see aircraft takeoff and land from my front porch so not seeing navigation lights really alarmed me. They appeared to fly about 2 miles apart and then they appeared to bank right turn to a visual landing at the field. Once they made the turn they appeared to fade out of sight one by one. The airfie! ld is 14 miles ESE of my position. The unusual thing was that the lights stayed at the same altitude when they turned, no sighs of desent or loss of altitude.

summary: Circular craft seen over Fort Mohave, Arizona with fast moving perimeter lights.
description: We observed to the Northeast and East 3 objects at very high altitude in almost a straight line. The object most visible was mainly circular in shape but appeared at times to change shape into an ellipse and so on. It appeared there were 3 lights rotating around it at very high speed creating a strobe effect and at the same time creating a rainbow effect in a circle around the perimeter. There may have been a dim center light. The second object was stationary and had green and blue lights which did not flash or rotate. The third object I could not see very well. The only way to view these was with a 36x spotting scope. I did not have a telescope. The objects intensity became dimmer and dimmer but never totally disappeared.

summary: Orange orb came close

summary: A BRIGHT blue, red, green, white globe that would go out and randomly change colors.
description:
I was on my way to walmart with my boyfriend when all of a sudden he point of this weird light to out right (west). He told me to turn in and park and we would start recording it.
 After we parked we got out of the car and it disappeared. 2 minutes top went by and we caught this glowing globe to our far right (east). "We thought it moved that fast?" weird right? I got out my camera and started recording. It was a glowing globe with no pattern in the changing of colors. it would be a BRIGHT blue and then BRIGHT red and go out and then white and out and green and red and out and blue.
 We noticed it standing still and went into the store. Coming out of the store about 20 minutes later, the glowing globe was still there and was still changing colors. We know it wasn't a plane. We've both seen planes, we actually saw 2 planes while watching the bright globe change colors.
Twinkling star? PD

summary: My wife and I observed chevron shaped lights moving across the sky
description:
My wife and I were sitting outside about 9pm on 2010/10/09 when we noticed something "floating" in the sky to the southwest of us and moving in what appeared to be a southerly direction. From the moment we noticed it to when it disappeared took at most maybe 30 seconds.
The shape of the object was hard to make out, it appeared washed out and possibly transparent with lights shaped similar to a delta wing aircraft with the exception that in the dront instead of being pointed it seemed curved much like a boomerang would be.
As I stated earlier, the object seemed to be floating across the sky, a very fluid movement with no jerkiness or changes in direction or speed up until the point that it just disappeared. It had been raining earlier that day, but the sky appeared clear of clouds since we could clearly see the stars and moon out.

summary: dark rectangular object ascended into the sky near St. Louis International airport
description:
On 10/12/2010, I saw a large dark colored rectangular object while in the parking lot of Quick Trip in Bridgeton, MO. This is near the St. Louis International Airport.
I was just about to leave when I noticed a man entering QT, who seemed fixed on the sky as he walked toward the entrance. Out of curiosity, I looked up and saw this dark rectangular object moving west very slowly. The object appeared to be moving at the distance one would expect a helicopter to fly. 
I got in my car then rolled down the window in order to hear if it made any noise which it did not. As I watched the object, it appeared to stop then it got smaller and smaller as if it were a helium balloon disappearing into the atmosphere.
I watched it for a minute or more, until I could no longer see it. 
As I was about to leave, the man I saw earlier exited the store. I asked him if he saw that and he said, "Did you see that?" I said, "Yes, did you see that?" again, and he then asked, "Did it fly over the store while I was inside?"
I told him how it ascended into the sky until I could no longer see it. 
I was still in awe of what I witnessed and just drove away. I felt relief that someone else confirmed seeing it.…

summary: Chevron shape lights moving slowly, Daphne AL
description:

At first glance I thought it was Jupiter between two stars then I remembered Jupiter was in the east right now. I stared at it and realized it was moving, rather slowly, as were the two other two objects beside it. the shape was of a chevron with a very bright object in front ( appeared slightly larger that Jupiter right now and as bright white or slightly brighter than Sirius) with the other 2 less bright ( slightly yellow or just dimmer ) to either side the formation pointing 220 degrees s-sw. the whole formation moved about 3" to 1/2 ft. in the visual plane in 45 seconds...I ran inside ( 20 ft ) yelled for my family to come see and by the time I went back out the object had disappeared, that was about 10 seconds or less. No solid object observed. No noises associated with the sighting. Skies clear, slight breeze, 75 F ambient temp.
 Observer is a 48 y/o salesman with Bachelors degree in Biology/chemistry 20/20 uncorrected vision. Lifelong astronomy enthusiast and avid sky watcher...with only one other "questionable sighting - not reported" in thousands…

summary: Bright white light cigar shaped object seen flying slowly to the north in slight decent.
description:
POSSIBLE UFO SIGHTING
On October 12, 2010 about 7:10 PM I was walking to my car when I looked up at the sky and saw a slender, elongated white light object traveling slowly in the sky toward the north. It did not change course or make any other movement other than traveling forward at a slight decent. 
There is no airport nearby in that direction. I watched it for about five minutes until it passed out of my sight range. The object had no structure, only bright white light. Therefore, it was definitely not a plane. Nothing was emitted from it, and I could hear no sound. 
The object was high in the sky, so did not get an up-close view of it.
The weather was clear, about 75 degrees, and no moisture.

summary: Similar white dots seen in NYC seen in Milpitas CA
description:
Having my morning tobacco break at about 10 AM I looked up to see one of the aircraft that was only minutes out of San Jose Airport when I noticed two points of light moving two or three full moon widths apart slowly drifting in a west to east direction. At first I thought they were coasting gulls and wondered why they would be so high.
I watched as long as my eyes could discern them disappearing over the Diablo range of mountains. Looking straight up again I observed two - four more of the white dots drifting in the same direction. At one point one of them appeared to be tumbling. I then noticed a large jet aircraft flying at an intermediate altitude also west to east along the same line. I thought it very unusual to see an aircraft at that altitude traveling west to east. Typically the aircraft have just taken off from San jose where they make a 180 degree turn to the south or they are lining up to land at Oakland in the north.
After the tumbling observation I wrote it off as spider webs. Told my wife about it when I got home and thought that was the end of the story. This morning I caught a glimpse of a video clip on google news (news organization not remembered) about the…

Like I said I thought they were spider webs until seeing the NYC videos. It registered in memory but not clearly. so this makes the report somewhat questionable but what can you do with a 58 year old memory.

I had not looked down for more than a second, and from my view I can clearly see the night sky and the surrounding area, it would have to have been a very fast object, or one that could easily disappear. I do not know what I saw, but I do know that where ever it went, it either got there quickly from a hovering position, or disappeared compl! etely.

summary: I was north on a mountain facing south with my friend.  We were star gazing and I looked up in the sky at about a 45 degree angle and saw a white light, which I thought was just a plane moving west…
Craft with two white lights in Minneapolis Approach Pattern that moved down and not forward then disappered behind the tree line.
description:
We were just finishing eating dinner when I saw a strange formation of lights out the window. I have aspirations to become an aerospace engineer and pilot and know alot about aviation so I can recognize my aircraft. 
This craft was totally out of the Minneapolis approah pattern and was fairly large looking. It consisted of simply two bright white lights that blinked in a few second intervals. The craft was directly in the KMSP approach pattern and was high above the houses at first. 
After just a few seconds the two lights dropped down fast until they went below the trees and houses just behind our house. I know that this was not an aircraft as it made no noise and had no other lights besides these two lights. It also moved down without moving forward.

I then looked up that zone in my FAA Minnesota Aviation Charts book and saw that it happened to be near where I saw the craft.

It took me several days to completely comprehend what I had observed.

The object was rather large but definitely smaller than the moon and appeared to be within our atmosphere. The object entirely disappeared and did not fizzle out, burn up or make impact; it was spherical and disappeared as such, without fragmenting. The object did not emit any sound.

We were both a bit shocked and pulled into a parking lot, got out and observed the light moving almost directly south for about two minutes. About half-way between our zenith and the horizon, it briefly swelled in brightness and dwindled.
The object was about five or six times the intensity of Jupiter...so it was very large in the night sky. It was moving about the typical speed of a satellite, but I have seen dozens, perhaps hundreds, of satellites and the similarities end at speed. I would estimate the altitude similar to a jet, based on observing a slight trajectory as the object moved away from us.
We got in the car, made note of the time and came home to check the satellite trackers. As far as we could find, there was nothing in our sky around 9:20. I wouldn't be filling out this report if the object wasn't so blatant!

My wife took the dog outside for the end of day walk ~8:20PM. During this event my wife spotted unusual lights in the N-NW sky. She came in the house and got the binoculars to get a closer look.

The object appeared to be floating in the distance. The size of the object appeared to be about the size of a planet but the lights and motion are unlike any object that we’ve witnessed.
The motion of the was very slight but was somewhat stationary for 8-10 minutes where its relative position moved very little in perspective using the tree as a reference point.
The lights were intense and primarily were white, red, green and blue. When viewed through the binoculars the lights appeared to rotate. No blinking but rotating on the object.
After 10 minutes the object slowly moved out of view into the branches. 
I moved to the front yard and continued to find the object through the branches until it was finally obstructed from view ~9:20P.

The more I thought about it, I couldn’t think of a bird in our area large enough to glide by with this effect. The herons & egrets in the area keep flapping their wings when they fly, so it couldn’t have been one of them since what I saw was a steady movement. It wasn’t Canadian Geese in formation either. Also, the object appeared quite large, so if it was a bird and it appeared that large to me, it would’ve been flying very low and I should’ve been able to see the body to some extent.
Since I could see no other part of the figure, I assume the object was at a pretty high altitude. If I’m correct in that assumption, then the object was quite large. After the object disappeared, I extended my arm and with my thumb and forefinger I approximated the size. The object from tip to tip of the bow (crescent?) was about an inch and a half spread of my thumb and forefinger with my arm extended.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: strange light in woods of Goldendale Washington
description:
I am writing to report several UFO sightings I have witnessed over the past 4 years. I am 33 years old, and have never seen a UFO before until 2010. I am a mother of two children (10 and 8 years old) and do not use drugs or alcohol. I am a stay-at-home mom who homeschools. Along with myself, my husband and two children have been co-witnesses to the sightings.
One of my neighbors was also present during one of the sightings.
In October 2010, I moved to Goldendale, Washington. We had just bought our 5 acre property and were living in a fifth wheel, while developing the property for a home. Our property is 15 miles outside of town and is in the woods. We had a small campfire and it was about 8pm at night. 
My husband and I were standing outside around the campfire and the children were there as well. It was a clear and cold October night sky. Though there were clouds in the sky, they were small with plenty of blue sky between them. The object did not fly behind a cloud, it vanished while I watched. The entire episode lasted about 3 seconds. The object was about the size of a quarter held at arm's length.
I’m a father in my mid-30s working in healthcare. I’m interested in UFOs, but I don’t necessarily think every sighting is anomalous or of an alien spacecraft. I’ve reflected on my sighting for several days and cannot come up with a reasonable explanation.

My wife and I were outside looking at the harvest moon and Jupiter, a few minutes after 9pm on September 22, when two lights became visible to the south-east of us, in the direction of LAX. 
At first I thought they were landing lights of jets coming towards us, but as we watched, they became bright orange and fiery, like the exhaust from a rocket launch. 
The skies were absolutely clear, and the full moon was lighting up everything so we could see that there was no smoke or contrail coming from the objects. 
We watched as the objects appeared to go straight up, then turn in different directions (toward the east and south), as they appeared to leave the atmosphere. 
The objects were about the size of half the diameter of a penny at arms length and were about two pennies apart. The observation lasted maybe two minutes.

As the object passed due North of our viewpoint, it bob up and then down, penetrated a small cloud and disappeared momentarily. It reappeared still heading east, then went dark for approximately one second, then standard aircraft lighting became visible. The object then began making noise consistent with a single-engine propeller driven aircraft. Prior to the lighting configuration change, the object had been silent. The object then continued on an eastward heading.

It came from the South and went directly over my vehicle, I couldn't make a good estimate on how high it was, however, it seemed rather low; the lights were extremely bright, almost like helicopter search lights. It moved rapidly to the North, and was out of sight just as quickly.
NOTE: This was very close to the Sioux Falls Airport.

summary: Bright light seen streaking across suburban Chicago sky.
description: At approximately 1:40 a.m., we witnessed a bright white light that streaked from east to west across the sky over Worth, Illinois. It did not appear to be a meteor, and seemed to be inside our own atmosphere. The actual craft or object disappeared in about a second, but left a trail (much like a jet-stream) that took several seconds to fade away. The stream did not stretch for the entire length that the object traveled, but only about a quarter of it. The stream also appeared to glow a bit, like the tail of a comet. The entire duration of the sighting, from first sight until the stream faded away, was about ten seconds.

summary: A plasma-like ball shot across the sky at an incredibly high speed and disappeared, leaving an eerie trail of light behind.

It was a clear night with no clouds in the sky. A bright object appeared in the sky and we all saw a bright purple and green ball shoot through the sky at a very high speed. It resembled a ball of plasma. It appeared to be close to the ground but not knowing size, it is hard to judge. It had what appeared to be a steam-like trail (similar to that of a jet) but had a glowing quality. The trail was erratic and began and ended at definite points. The object appeared for a second and disappeared the same as it appeared. The trail stayed in the sky for close to four seconds and then disappeared at once. It did not dissipate from one end to the other. It was not a shooting star, or meteor. It was nothing like any of us have ever seen and strongly resembled the sighting from Naperville, IL.

summary: round bright circling orb around tower

We watched for a couple of hours and then periodically up to about 3:30am. 
The light or orb would have moved away further every time we checked. 
I went to bed and looked for any evidence of anything that might be of explanation the next morning. 
The sky was clear and blue and no sign of anything hanging around the tower or it's cables. 
I have never seen anything like what we experienced and felt compelled to share our experience.

It would be stationary for a few seconds or less and then move in short, quick bursts; up and down, left and right, even diagonally. At one point I thought I saw a single light leave or drop from the object but it was faint and I'm therefore uncertain. So far the object has been visible for twenty minutes.

summary: silent, slow airborn globe that accelerated suddenly and straight upwards, without a sound
description: Completely silent. Large, slow moving orange globe. Slowly moving towards my car. Very steady, altitude unable to determine. There were low clouds and high clouds and wind. Object was sometimes behind low clouds. Object glowed, did not have light beam as helicopter or plane. I stopped my engine, no other cars present. Absolutely no sound. I decided to follow. Object was at the corner of 156th Ave SE and 16th St SE in Bellevue Wa. It turned north near 156th. I was reaching for my keys when it immediately and extremely fast, moved north and straight up. It went from what appeared to be a slow cruise to an unbelievable rate of acceleration. There was no sound. That is all I can tell you. I hope there was someone else who reported this.

summary: It was a very bright light, extremly high up that was brighter than anything else in the night sky

description:
On Saturday nights, I sing onboard the historic Dixie, Indiana’s, oldest paddle-wheel tour boat on Webster Lake in North Webster, Indiana. Weather permitting, I perform on the top deck of the boat which is uncovered. We have a clear, unobstructed view up there of the night sky. 
On 09-14-10 ((sic. 09-04-10)), the sky was mostly clear with a few light clouds here and there. The sky was a sea of stars and there was no moon. The day had been windy, but by our 9PM departure time, it was very calm on the lake.
At about 10 PM, we were emerging from a bay in the southeast corner of the 600-acre lake and were traveling west at about 5 miles per hour on the last leg of our tour. I was just finishing a song when the captain of the boat tapped me on the shoulder and pointed into the night sky directly above the boat, calling my attention to a very strange spectacle.
An object was flying very slowly in a due east direction above and to the port (left) side of our paddleboat. It was so strange, I called the attention of the passengers to this object. There were about 15 people on the upper deck, all of whom had a perfectly clear view of the object simply by looking up, and approximately 30…

summary: Large round gray object moving low to the ground making no sound.
Slow moving silent orange coloured UFO
description:
I was returning home from posting a letter when I looked up at the sky and saw a large, orange circle, moving slowly. It wasn't very high up and I got a very good look at it. It travelled behind me and continued on. I ran to tell my daughter and we both went outside to see if we could see it again. We both saw it again as it passed over. There was no flashing light or sound. It moved slowly.
We assume that the sighting occurred on September 04, 2010, and we have amended the date above, to reflect that fact. PD

A second object to the South and East moved laterly a few seconds later and then repeated the same falling and moving to the North at a very fast speed. Neither object left amy kind of trail. They were up so high they did not change size and kept the same brightmess until they evaporated moving to the North.

summary: Bright fast object moving across sky suddenly vanished

I saw a very large bright "something" moving fast in the sky going East. I thought it was a Satelite but have never seen one that bright. I kept my eye on it but then a flash of lighting was seen in the distance, however I never took my eyes off it then it suddenly vanished. The sky was clear.... It was no where in the sky to be seen again.

summary: Glowing low flying triangular shaped object slowly flew over us, appeared to be on fire but didn't loose altitude.
description: My family and I were sitting in our front yard watching the fireworks at the Herrington Lake Marina to the right, and as one of the fireworks went off we noticed a glowing object in the sky to our left. Even though it was dark at this point, it did not appear to be very high in the sky so at first we assumed it must be a large piece of flaming debris from one of the fireworks; however, the debris did not lose altitude and float to the ground. It appeared to be on fire and it also traveled on a straight, unwaivering path, which continued to fly at the same altitude until we could no longer see the object. While the object could have possibly be triangular in shape it was hard to see because it was so illuminated although it did appear to have flames coming from the back of the object. It did not appear to be traveling at a great rate of speed. There was only one object and the color was kind of a bright yellow orange like fire.

summary: 8 bright white lights ...unidentified shape...

I stood and watched it--unable to tell the exact shape, but the object had 8 lights that went out periodically, but I suspect that the lights weren't really going on, but rather cloud cover. summary: Radiating ball  of light tracking due east for approx 2 minutes.
description:
At 8:19 PM CST above the skies of Will County, Illinois, there was a radiating ball of red light tracking due east at a rate of movement far too slow to be a meteor, or satellite. After approximately 45 seconds to a minute of this tracking it made a sudden 90 degree turn due south, and became gradually dimmer. It tracked south for approximately 5 to 10 seconds and made another 90 degree turn due east and proceeded on this course for another 5 to 10 seconds. It made another 90 degree turn south and then another east, traveling in each direction for 5 to 10 seconds. It then disappeared spontaneously.
The object left no contrail or smoke trail and made no noise. The object was not any perfect shape, but more resembled a radiating ball of fire. After it’s apparition it became gradually dimmer until to point of disappearance.

Three orange glowing lights traveling together in the form of a verticle triangle in the night disappear into the clouds.

Rockford does have an airport and we have seen planes often. Planes have red flashing and white lights and make noise. Not these orange passing what ever they were lights passing in the night sky just above our heads! They faded into some clouds and then disappeared. I doubt anyone would be flying in a hot air balloon in the dark. And three of them at that. And then to be perfectly traveling together in the shape of a perfect triangle. Too weird. Also, I did witness an air plane near the object.

But, this light was so bright I couldn’t ignore it. Note, it was not dark yet, I did not have my headlights on yet. The size was approximately the same diameter as holding the round end of a pencil eraser at arms-length. But, immediately I noticed the object the light was attached to. It was round (well, circular looking at to directly) and very dark, almost black. So it seemed to create a black halo (though obviously solid) around the light (keep in mind the sk! y was still bright and light blue at the time). We observed a small dark cloud pass between the object and ourselves. once behind the cloud or puff of dark smoke (to me,the cloud seemed unnatural)both the cloud and the silver sphere vanished.

summary: White light over the ocean at York Beach Maine
description:
Stationary light over ocean off York beach Maine. Very very bright white light. Appeared to be about five miles out over Atlantic and appeared while it was still daylight. At first it didn't move at all, as a planet or star or satellite moves. Remained stationary for a half an hour, then headed due south, slowly, away from my vantage point. As it moved away it remained just as bright as when it first appeared.
During this time I saw commercial aircraft with navigation lights over the ocean in the same general area but their lights were faint and difficult to see.
By comparison to the navigation lights, the white light was extremely bright and very large. Couldn't have been landing lights of an aircraft as the object, whatever it was, was completely stationary for such a long period of time, then moved in a straight line away from me.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Bright unmoving light i high in the clear sky.
description:
Walking up the street. Weather conditions were clear skies, no clouds, no significant wind and temperature around75 degrees F.
I saw a white spot of light in the sky, it appeared to be very high altitude, I thought it possibly could be Venus. The light was a yellow, white pin point of light. It was unmoving, I called my son who joined me in the street and helped him locate the object. He has had astronomy classes in college, but could not think of anything we would be able to see in that location at that time of day.
The light was an estimated 50 -60 degrees from the horizon and roughly 105 degrees from north. These estimates were made after I got home and tried to recreate the positioning from memory.
The light never moved and seemed steady, no flashing, blinking or twinkling like a star. no sounds were heard, but non were expected due to the appearance being so high.
After about 10-15 minutes we both lost sight of the object and could not locate it again.

summary: Cylinder seen disappearing over P.A.R.I. in Rosman, NC
description:
I was standing on the deck of trailer at he end of Craven Lane in Rosman, N.C. I looked up towards the mountaintop cross the French Broad river and saw movement in the sky southwest of me towards the P.A.R.I. station on highway 215. 
There were no clouds or birds flying over me. The sky over head was a bright autumn blue and absolutely empty. 
A silver or gray cylinder was moving left across the mountaintop. At first, I thought I was observing a jet from the rear when I noticed there were no wings. 
It rotated slightly and the sun glinted off the bottom of the craft. It didn't grow smaller like a plane flying away from you. The cylinder just moved southwest and disappeared. 
If you held your thumb up in the sky as a reference, the craft would have been as wide as your thumbnail. 
At no time did I hear any sound. 
The whole episode lasted about fifteen seconds. This was as real as if you were watching a small airplane just fly a short distance and then watc! h it wink out of sight. 
I am a 56 year old woman not given to flights of fancy and have never seen anything like this before in my life.

summary: My wife and I regularly hike in the Brown County State Park in the evenings.  On our drive home at about 8:55 p.m, we passed a cleared lookout spot on top of one of the park’s hills and saw several…
description:
The park has many of these scenic overlooks where trees have been removed and people can pull their cars off the roads and view forested hills, perhaps as far away as 15-25 miles. Brown County is very rural and covered with forested hills. There is no town, or towers, or any high structures in the direction of these lights. However, Camp Atterbury, a military camp, is about 10 miles east of this location.
For the next four minutes or so, we watched these lights come on, stay lit about 30 seconds or so, and then go off, fading quickly. We noticed as one light would go out, another would often come on in another location. Often, the lights seemed to be grouped in a diamond-shape pattern, but this shape changed as a light would go off. We saw as many as 5 lights at one time, and as few as one, before all of them went completely out. They appeared, at first, to be stationary, but through careful observation we noticed that lights would go slightly out of alignment with each other, suggesting very slow movement. We wondered if these lights were attached to a larger shape or form that we could not make it out. They were bright and it was getting dark. It is also hard to say how far away…

summary: Gray, saucer-shaped object spotted near Covina.
description: At around 9:30 pm on September 2nd, 2010, my friends and I came back from a football game and were waiting at the front of our school for our parents to pick us up. We were talking and joking around when suddenly my friend sitting next to me yells, "U.F.O!!!" and points northeast. Instinctively, we all looked in that direction. And there, against a clear, pitch-black sky, one gray, saucer-shaped object was moving right to left at a relatively fair speed. It was obviously too fast to be a cloud and it was almost a complete impossiblity as there were no other clouds in the sky. We shouted and yelled "oh my god!" in disbelief as it got smaller and smaller. The object was only visible for about ten seconds until it disappeared.

summary: orange light, possible fireball, against night sky, minimal clouds, no stars
description: A single orange light was observed at approximately 9:30pm around Lakeshore drive just north of Carrigan road. The light moved a bit faster than a standard airplane. It could not have been mistaken for an airplane as there were no flashing lights typically seen on the wing of an airplane. It’s possible that it could have been a fireball/comet/meteor although there was no “tail” typically seen on such an occurrence. There were minimal clouds and no stars were present. The event lasted about a minute until it was lost behind dense tree coverage. The object flew in a more-or-less straight path with a bearing directly north east. It was also continuous and did not fade, nor get brighter during the sighting.

summary: Bring blue light seen traveling across the south western sky at high speed.

The light then flew at high speed to about 35° high off the southern horizon then abruptly stopped for about 5 seconds or so. After stopping the light then changed directions to head west at a much faster speed then disappeared behind the mountains. The whole encounter lasted about 25 or so second and the light didn’t seem blink or change colors in any way.

summary: Tiny object seen flying close to large airplane.
description:
While lounging outside, looked up and saw large airplane flying west to east. If due north on a level plane is 9 o'clock and due south on a plane is 3 o'clock and Hades is at 6, then the airplane was flying at about 11. While observing the airplane, I noticed what seemed to be an extra part hanging off of one of the wings and wondered if the plane was coming apart. Then the piece, which was not much larger than a dot, moved so that it appeared as if it were flying between the airplane's south (near) wing and its tail. That's when I realized it was a separate, flying object. As I watched the dot seemed to vanish for a moment and then I noticed it now flying just in front of the aircraft. They both then passed over the Cleveland Avenue hill extremely close together. I checked my watch, which read 7:56 PM.
 It seemed way to small to be a regular aircraft. The airplane's apparent length was slightly less than the diameter of a dime held at arm's length. The object flying around it appeared smaller than any of the engines.
 If any reports of a jet being buzzed come in for tonight, you've got ground corroboration.

We have not seen it since. But I am truly scared knowing that this very well may be a U.F.O.

summary: I was looking out of my bedroom window that night because i couldnt sleep and saw something in the sky at 10:25pm, with flashing red, blue, and yellow lights and it wasnt moving at all. and I saw the…
My wife and I were star gazing at approximately 10 to on September 1, 2010.
description:
At about 10:10pm with a crystal clear sky, I noticed a round kind of dark dot in the sky to the west. I pointed this out to my wife and she saw it immediately. The object came closer and closer and it appeared to be an irregular shape, the shape of a police badge. No lights were on this object and it did not make any noise. 
 As it went overhead we could see that it was a subdued color illuminated by the reflection of the city lights. It looked to be a muddy, brown color. From our point of view, it seemed to be very large, moving in the horizon. It quickly left our view, moving a west-to-east direction. We saw the bottom of the object as it went over us. It looked eerie; it was a muddy brown color with a little pink reflected from the city lights. It went directly overhead and it was definitely an irregular shape, the shape of a police badge. The whole spotting time was approximately 1½ to 2 minutes in duration. 
It was going horizon to horizon and looked like the size of a full moon. The trajectory was close to perfect, going west to east. 
The next morning I spent my time on the phone trying to see if anyone else had reported anything, so far I haven’t heard anything.

summary: Bright light in the skies south of Maricopa, AZ increases luminosity before additional lights spawn and streak away.
description:
Driving home southbound on Ralston Rd- a large, very bright yellow/orange light in the southern sky caught my attention. Knowing the sky after living out here for a few years, I quickly made the mental note that it wasn’t a star. As I looked at the light it increased in luminosity rapidly. This increase took place very quickly- I would say within 5 seconds and made the light/object appear to increase in size dramatically. Additional lights then blinked on in quick succession- first one to the east, then one to the west, and another even further west. The additional lights came on at a luminosity that matched the first light. They were evenly spaced, making me wonder if they were separate or part of one large object. All the lights rose simultaneously- moving upward and southward at great speed, disappearing from sight.
I have seen numerous things in the night sky out here- this is the first that I cannot come up with an explanation for. I am used to seeing flares over the hills to the west of my home, and I am familiar with both military and commercial air traffic that frequents our skies. The size and brightness of the light I saw was well in excess of the luminosity of the stars…

summary: Triangle in Marietta near Barret and Dallas highway.
description:
Driving east on dallas highway past Barret Parkway not too far from Kennessaw Mountain. Triangle (3 lights on formation at approximatly 45 degree angle from each other) hovering above the tree line near Avonwood drive, there is a subdivision near by. 
We saw driving it east and thought maybe it was a cell tower but the lights were too far from each other. We turned around to go west and find a near by street to get a closer look and it had disapeared in the few minutes it took to turn around.

summary: 1 main object, seconndary at higher elevation smaller  2large, bright cigar/chevron shapes
description:
Tonight, 31 August, 2010, @ 20:13, We witnessed 1 cigar/chevron shaped object appear, very bright, to the west of Burlingame. "One”"appears near the horizon but above the buildings on W Santa Fe Ave (south side), the 2nd ("Two") appeared 2 minutes later, again much higher in the sky and to the north.
They hovered from 20:24, until about 21:30.
At 21:15, "One" faded in and out again, glowing red, then disappeared. There was quite a bit of lightning to the north and west and cloud cover prevented me from seeing if it reappeared due east of Burlingame(66413) I thought I saw two others converge and maintain a single stance to the southeast of "One"

summary: Cigar shaped object, flashes twice, separates into 2 spheres, joins as one ball of light and vanishes!
description:
It was around 19:30, while out fishing, I noticed an object about 9 thousand feet in the western sky. The sky condition was fairly clear, with a high level haze (no clouds), the sun was near setting. A star was visible at the time. No other aircraft visible.
The object first appeared to be a cigar shape aircraft, no wings, no noise, no vapour trail, it was metallic, glowing, shinning very brightly and was moving slowly in a south west direction.
The object then flashed brightly, twice and slowly separated evenly, into two spherical objects, and then joined together into one round bright object, like a ball of bright light.
The ball of light grew in intensity, then quickly faded away and vanished.
The total time of observation was about 10-15 seconds.
I have worked in the aviation industry for thirty years, beside an airport and have seen countless aircraft take-off and depart. This object did not resemble anything I have seen before.
I have seen many aircraft flying at high altitudes, twenty to thirty thousand feet in the same area. This object was clearly visible and I estimate the altitude to be around nine thousand feet.

summary: 3 chamber, triangle shaped object
description:
It was not moving at, more hovering before moving every so slowly south. It was silver, not shiny, and it had 3 circular compartments connected by metal bars, in the shape of a triangle. 
There wasnt any sound that i could tell. I mention this becaseu it was out in the courty and often times we can hear planes even when we cant see them. 
For a second before it began moving, I thought I saw a very light greenish glow casting downwads, but it could have been my mind playing tricks on me.

summary: Orange flickering orb of light flying low and slow in Oregon
description:
I was walking back from a nearby convenience store at right around 11:00pm on August 30, 2010. The moon was about three quarters full but close to the eastern horizon so the stars were very clear. Veneta is very small town so there is not much in the way of lights to block out the sky so I was checking it out as I walked.
To the south I saw an orange slightly flickering light moving north toward my position very slowly. The object was moving parallel to Territorial Highway and just barely east of it. The color seemed strange but I assumed whatever it was would become more easily identifiable, once it got closer, in the form of clearly blinking lights or lights other than the flickering orange. This however was not the case. Its appearance did not change in any way. I could not make out any definite shape or see anything other than just an orange slightly flickering light. Judging by my perception of its altitude it was not a very large object.
I remained in place in the parking lot of the Veneta public library watching as it moved at a speed of about 15 mph or less at an altitude of approximately 150 to 200 feet. I could hear no sound coming from its direction. When it had reached…

summary: Orange light, with no noise flying level, then climbing rapidly.
description:
At 22:00 on 30 August 2010 was driving home when we spotted an object (an orange light) seen flying level and approaching from northerly direction. 
Object stopped and reversed course before hovering, then climbing rapidly to the east before disappearing from view on what is a very clear night. 
No noise. Photographs taken. 
Are used to seeing helicopters and high flying aircraft in area, but this had no other identifying lights,

summary: Came out on front step looked west sky had breaking clouds in the break I saw strange lights moving N.W. counted 13 called for my daughter in a row in clouds they disappeared not spaced evenly
I am familiar with aircraft and this object  preformed like and aircraft but weird at low altitude and nighttime over populated area.
description:
red and green lights similar to those in a light aircraft except green is much brighter. NO sound associated with object. Object was performing complex maneuvers over a populated area at night.
Sky was partially covered by a low marine layer the object was operating below the level of this layer.

summary: One round ball of fire floating over Spring Hill, Florida
description:
On August 30, 2010 at 20:43 my husband and I were sitting outside on our front porch when he said to me "What is that?" I looked over to my right and up and saw a slowly moving orange fire ball going over our house in a straight line. He knocked on the window to get the attention of my 14 year old son who looked out the window and then ran out. Once it was over the street I ran inside for my camera.
I realized my SD card was not inside of it as we just returned from Mexico. By the time i got back outside, the fire ball was gone. My husband had come in and grabbed his camera off of the counter and was able to get a few seconds of this, but it was not clear and the ball of fire looked too small and white in the video. I asked where it went and my son said it went in a straight line, never stopping, and then it curved to the left and sped up and then disappeared.
We went inside and about 15 minutes later I heard a helicopter. We went outside and saw it flying slowly over our house and then in the direction that the light had come from. It proceeded to then fly over a few more times. It never went in the direction that the object flew towards.
We live less than 10 miles from the Gulf…

summary: Bright light moving silently and beyond our capabilities.
description:
Noticed it while I was walking my dog. Bright light above the houses across the street from my own. 
Moved at varying speeds and multiple directions. It also slowed to a stop and hovered. Absolutely no sound. 

From a distance the light looked white. As it got closer it appeared to be blue/green. Could see normal air traffic flying above and behind it. This really gave a good sense of the speed and maneuverability of the object. 
This was the second time I have seen this object. This time I caught it on video.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

summary: Jets chasing illuminated object
description:
One large object with a dull orangish colored glow. First being followed by what looked like 2 jets. 
A few minutes later 2 more jets joined and now four jets with lots of very bright white blinking lights are all following the glowing object. 
All objects were traveling to the south and remained visible until objects were too distant in the night sky.

summary: Shiny metallic upside down cone shaped object over Jersey Shore.
description:
The sky was crystal clear and the humidity was very low, below 40%.The wind was calm at ground level. I noticed three distinct clouds that caught my intrest. Two were parallel to each other looking like they had been emitted by jet exhaust. They were approximately two miles long. 
There was also another cloud just to the east/ south east that was fatter and shorter and was directly over me at one point. All three clouds were dispersing their content as they were being gently moving with the wind to the east / south east. The short fat cloud looked rather strange at the time slowly turning into a circular shape with a waterfall of mist being left behind. 
While I was looking at this I notice a stationary speck in the sky just under this cloud. I quickly (10 to 15 seconds) retrieved my binoculars and focused on this object. It moved up into this cloud for 20 seconds then moved back down. When it had cleared the cloud I could see it was a shiny metallic object,! upside down cone shape with a domed top. It was hovering near the cloud for approximately 20 seconds and then started moving down in a slow fluid motion occasionally skipping North East on its seeming descent. It only took 20…

summary: Disc shaped object with pulsing outer band and transparent center.
description:
Round disc shaped with white and silver pulsing outer band, the center looked see through. The object hovered in the sky. 
After 30 to 45 seconds it blinked twice and disappeared.

summary: Orange fireballs resolving into something solid after slowing down.
description: 1st, saw orange fireball moving from South/Southwest to North/Northeast. Almost 3 minute duration. Very high up in the sky until it flared out. Second was about 2 minutes later, same direction, but much lower. When the flare of orange went out, it appeared to be an oval shaped craft much lower in the sky. No wings and no apparent aerodynamics. It took about 4 minutes to traverse the sky from South to North/northeast. The 3rd was another fireball moving much faster and higher in the sky then the first one. Meanwhile, sirens from the local police and fire department were going off continuously. They were also moving north. NO FLASHING LIGHTS were visible on the objects at anytime and they were in Bishop International Airport airspace. We have planes go over us continuously and these were not planes.

summary: Black oval shape w/heat waves visible over 5 freeway in Silverlake
description:
On the morning of August 30, 2010, I was taking pictures of the beautiful sunrise in LA, looking southeast from my balcony toward Eagle Rock and the 5 freeway. I took 15-20 pics every couple of minutes as the sun broke through the clouds.
The following morning I downloaded the pics off the camera and saw this black, oval object toward the right of the clouds that I did not see while taking the pictures. It only appeared in this one picture so I am CERTAIN it is not a dust speck on the lens. I can see heat waves around it. 
Also, I am pretty sure it’s not a helicopter. They fly over all the time and I hear them. 
This was a silent morning, except for the freeway sounds below.

summary: translucent pink orange colors, bird shape, 5 of them making a formation of a triangle as they move foward on a swimming motion,
description:
Today August 30, 2010 clear sky and many stars, the location of the incident was in Valrico, Florida. About 5:15 A.M this morning. I went outside to my courtyard to drink my coffee and admired the sky like I usually do. 
I have been starring at the sky for couple of minutes, when I saw what appears to me as clouds approaching but I realized that it was more like a flock of birds flying high in the sky,(high up like a cloud) about 5 of them crossing the sky from west to east forming a like triangle. Each bird shape appears to be like three times the size of the moon when you see it from the ground; the stars appear very small next to each of them in size like dots.
What I found to be strange was the color and the way they moved forward. Their color was like the fire from a lighter; translucent with a pink-orange tone the only thing I can compare them to is to clouds in the horizon when the morning is breaking through. However keep in mind that is was still dark outside, only the moon and the stars shining. The way they moved was like it was gliding in the sky, like swimming in the ocean. They were out of sight in about 10 seconds. It was an incredible!

summary: Bright, stationary object next to the moon, gone the next day.
description:
I am an 18 year old male. It was late at night about a week ago and I was looking up towards the moon. Directly to the left of the moon was an unusual light. It somewhat resembled a star at first, but then it became clear that it was giving off both blue and red light, and also had a shaft of light on the front of it, which distorted its twinkling, and made it look more unusual. I watched the object for several minutes, wondering what it was. It stayed stationary the whole time, and eventually I went to bed. 
This object was very bright and memorable. I witnessed a similar object the next night, elsewhere in the sky. Once again I observed it for several minutes and it stayed stationary. These objects are no longer in the sky. The moon offered a great reference point for the first one I saw, since it was so close to the left of the moon, and it is obvious that whatever it was is now gone. That’s all there was to it!

summary: the objects were glowing red and white and moving about slowly
description:
we saw three circular objects glowing white to red hovering in the sky. The objects were moving slightly left, up, down, right. Then at times they would move great distances away and back around the area where we first spotted them.

(They both looked liked a military style parachute flares) My wife moved to the front of the hose and watched it move from right to left and moving downwards (further away) before it became to small to see with here eyes.

summary: A silent moving object with very bright yellow-white lights.
description:
The object consisted of three very bright, yellow-white , oval lights. It was shaped in a triangle. It moved with absolute silence over a portion of the back of my property. When it moved behind a large pine tree, I temporarily lost sight of it. When it didn't emerge, I moved and saw that it was now a pinpoint of light and was gone.
I am a woman with two adult children, retired from being a teacher's aide for 7 months.

summary: Two mysterious objects flying near Waterloo
description:
On August 29th, 2010, yesterday night, I was returning home with my family from Grand Bend, Ontario.
We were driving E.(East) on Highway 7 near Waterloo at the time. According to Google Maps the exact towns name is Wilmot, Ontario.
 The highway did not have any lights on the side of the road, making it very easy to see the stars in the sky. At 21:50 (9:50pm) I was looking out the window from the back seat of the car (right side) and was looking at the stars, which I enjoy watching occasionally at home. When I was looking up, I noticed two objects straight up very far off in the distance moving across the sky very quickly from right to left.
The objects were moving very fast side by side from the right side to the left side. At first, the objects were traveling beside each other, but after a couple of seconds the object farthest away from me quickly turned and started separating from the other object. After a few more seconds, the objects once again started traveling parallel to each other.
 I told my younger brother who was also with me that I see something strange in the sky, he looked up and also saw the two objects. He also said they did not look like planes or satellites.
 I…

summary: Rapidly moving formation of lights.
description:
I was leaving for work Sunday night and looked up in the sky to check the weather. To the north I saw a fuzzy blob that was coming my way very fast. 
It quickly became several points of light that flew over slightly east of my position and kept going south until they vanished into the sky glow over Salt Lake City to the south.
There must have been about two dozen of them flying in formation. They looked like stars of medium intensity, that is, they were the about the same size and color. It wasn't a fixed pattern but they moved in relation to each other. There was no sound that I could hear and the lights did not flash or leave a trail. They covered about 2/3 of the visible sky in about 10 seconds. There was no telling how high or how fast they were actually going but I’m guessing they were about the height of the nearby mountain tops.

summary: An object with lights hovered in the night sky for 3 minutes
description: I was walking down a lane going to my house and looking at the stars. At about 9:15 PM I looked to the north and I saw what appeared to be an airplane in the night sky to the north. The object had a red light on it and a white light on it. I continued walking, but when I looked back a minute later I noticed that the object had not moved at all. Thinking that this was weird I stopped and watched the object for a couple minutes. The object continued to stay in the same spot in the sky for the entire time that I watched it. I continued walking toward my house while watching the object, and as I neared my house I ran inside to tell my family to come look at the UFO. They immediately ran out to see it, but by the time we looked again it had vanished. After talking to them about the object my brother informed me that a friend of his had seen it the night previous in a similar area of sky.

summary: Bright object seen moving north of Riverhead, Long Island, NY.
description:
I have been witnessing a very bright unknown lighted object in the sky to the west of my residence. Even with the use of a decent set of binoculars, I have been unable to determine exactly what it is. I have been seeing the exact same object almost every night for the last two weeks. It moves very slowly to the north until it can no longer be seen. I would estimate that the object is flying somewhere over riverhead or calverton, then north to the long island sound out of my view.
 I'm definitely not implying that this is an alien spacecraft, but I would like to know exactly what it is. If you live on eastern long island and have been seeing this same object, please report it on this site.

summary: Red and white lights, Seen on Rt. 44 east shortly before Esta Rd
description: Driving east on rt. 44 (coming up on Esta Rd)saw object hovering about 20 feet above tree tops, and about 10 feet away from road, approximately where there is a pond. Coming up on it I thought it was a helicopter (possibly looking for the couple of people that have been reported missing over the past couple weeks). As I drove a little closer i realized that it was not a helicopter. it was pefectly still and made no noise (windows down and no radio). Driving under it i noticed the triangle pattern of lights. i drove past it and turned around, in that time it was gone. Thinking that maybe becasue where i turned around was at the bottom of a hill so maybe that was why i couldnt see it, i back tracked. also to make sure maybe it wasnt just a pole with lights or something but it was indeed completely gone.

summary: Gathering of a dozen or more orange lights in the northeastern sky -  a "gathering"
description: In the northeastern sky, a very bright orange light was observed, not moving and stationary against the background sky. Thinking this was just an aircraft moving in my line of sight (stationary), I opened the blinds to get a better look, only to discover three more bright orange lights below this object, moving towards it. No sounds of aircraft was present. The lights joined up, formed a semi-circle, then the end light faded away leaving the remaining three lights to form a triangle (picture available), only to fade away as if moving into a fog. From the East, more orange lights continued to appear sometimes two or three at a time moving through the tree line, joining up with the other objects, pausing, then fading away. At any given moment, there was a dozen lights in the sky. It was as if this was a "gathering". This gathering lasted 20 minutes.

summary: Fireball becomes a saucer right in front of my eyes!!!
description:
I was nearing the intersection where I would be turning right (south) towards I-12. Facing north, I noticed a fireball moving in the northeast night sky. I asked my friend, "What is that?!", pointing it out. She locked on to it easily. The apparent flaming orb stopped moving and hovered. The "flame" went out and the object appeared as having red stationary lights, with white blinking lights.
The light turned green and we darted straight across the highway (east). The lights seemed so close, perhaps within a couple hundred yards high. Coming to a clearing in the trees on my left I saw it just hanging there! I threw on the emergency brake and we both got out of the car. I fumbled with my new phone wanting to take pics or video. I was too rattled and unfamiliar with it to be successful. There was NO sound.
I could make out the shape and surface texture of a metallic disk, the lights under the belly. It was not smooth, but pitted like welding slag. Our jaws were hanging for 20 seconds or so, then the disk turned on its axis and stood like a wheel. 
I'm constantly asking, "Do you see this??!" 
It moved SSW and when we turned to follow it, when I noticed cars were backing up behind us,…

summary: 3 lights, flying just above treetops headed east on Rt. 44 just past the highway.
description:
I am reporting this months later because I stumbled on this website. I just wanted to say that I saw what had to be the same UFO as the post I saw sighted by Esta Rd. on Rt. 44. When I saw it, it was headed east on Rt. 44, just past the intersection of Rt. 3 (a highway). While Rt. 44 is not a highway, it is a very busy street with grocery stores, gas stations and such, and it was flying much lower and slower than an airplane would fly. It made no sound. It had 3 unblinking orbs of light, and was clearly triangle shaped. It wasn't much higher than the treetops. I had just pulled into a grocery store parking lot, saw it, stopped the car, rolled down the windows, and my son and I just stared at it and watched it head east down 44.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: Strange round translucent object with white light on top
description:
On Sunday,August 29th,2010 while at home in Oshawa,Ontario.

summary: Multiple witnesses of 2 flying disks in Newark, DE on 08/29/10
description: While driving to the Christiana Mall in Newark today, I noticed two metallic disks flying rather close to one another. They were absolutely silent and moved slightly sporadically. The disks were spinning, but not on a perfect axis. They were not in sync, but they stayed relatively close to one another for the approximate two minutes in which I observed them. It seemed as though they were moving closer and they flew higher extremely fast. From my perspective, it seemed as if they flew straight up into the sky. I was able to keep an eye on the objects the whole time until I had to travel below an overpass and I lost sight of the objects, which were very far away the last time I had my eye on them. I was a passenger in a car with two other people, who both observed the objects. Traffic notably slowed down on the exit ramp, as I assume that other drivers noticed them as well. The sighting did not have any physical effects on me or on any of the other passengers in the car that I was traveling in. As one who takes…

summary: Bright flashing light travels erratically in both pulsing pattern and trajectory for extended period
description: I was scanning the sky using high quality 10x50 binoculars when I saw a stationary bright object flashing just north and slightly below the moon. Within seconds it started heading "down" starting with a basic flashing pattern of 2 and 1, but then it changed along with its trajectory. The light was extremely bright most of the time, and then it would dim-- the timing was very erratic, and it just darted about. It stayed in the vicinity of the moon and Jupiter for about 20 minutes and I finally went inside. With binoculars, you got the sense that whatever it was, it was trying to get attention, as anyone scanning the sky with equipment at that time could not have missed it. It could not, however be seen by the naked eye. Before I went inside, I saw a perfect rectangle cloud directly overhead.

summary: Strange yellowish orange light moving quickly across the sky in Chesterfield, MO
description: I saw a yellowish orange bright light about 100 ft above the house tops as it was moving through the trees. It was moving parallel to the ground and very fast. I looked up, saw it shooting across the sky and then it was gone behind some more trees.

summary: floating object and strange lights in the sky.
description:
I work night shift at the Clarian Arnett Hospital as a nursing assistant. I was on my way back from getting food on my break around 2:10 am, and saw a floating object directly over the intersection in front of the hospital. It was just over the traffic lights. I stopped (at a green light) to see what it was but cannot wrap my head around what I saw.
It was grayish blue, there were no streetlights just car headlights, it is very dark around the hospital, and I estimate it as being the size of a large dog. To me it looked like some sort of creature, floating silently and slowly straight up. No drifting or blowing in the wind. It had what looked like a very large head with the rest of the body which did appear to have 4 appendiges about the same size as the head, and it appeared to be almost upside down. it didnt move, just floated up as if being lifted from the sky. I turned around and went back, and it was gone.
I parked in the back of the hospital parking lot and a man with a little boy were walking out to the road pointing and looking where the object had been. I walked up to him and asked if they saw it too and if they knew what it was. He said that he did, he was able to see it…

summary: UFO appearing 4 nights in a row
description:
This occurrence has taken place on August 26th-29th 2010. It begins at around 2: am until 5: am. It is only one object in the Western sky, about a hands width away from the Big Dipper. Visible to the naked eye are blinking lights. 
When looking through binoculars it is rounded in shape, and pulsates different colours, it appears to take on different shapes such as circular, and oval, and within the shape there are lines running through it glowing different colours. Bright white is the predominate colour with red, blue, and green. It flies in no set pattern, it will hover then move diagonally hover again and then move vertically. It will also move in a circular pattern. The object rests for no longer than 30 seconds and will move in an unpredictable flight pattern. 
My husband as well as my two sons have witnessed this object ages 53, 25, 18. My 25 year old son is a firefighter and he is not believing what he is seeing, actually none of us are. Please ! Help

summary: multicolored lights, random fast movement, hovering, blinking

summary: Twin Shores Prince Edward Island, bright orange orb-like UFO reported in the sky
description:
My friend and I were camping at twin shores, PEI. We were walking to the bathroom to get ready for bed at around 12:30 (midnight), we heard someone yelling from the beach and we walked to the beach where we witnessed for about 2 minutes a circular like fireball object, it was in the sky about 1/7th the size of the moon when we first saw it. 
It was kind of like a bright orange orb that glowed on the outside, and when it got further away it ressembled a fireball. 
We watched it to the point where it was too far away to see.

summary: Orange orb floating over Baltimore
description:
An unexplained orange light was observed by over 15 to 20 patrons on the roof terrace of a nightclub in Baltimore, MD, at approximately 12:15 AM on Sunday, August 29, 2010.
I first noticed an unusual glowing orange shape in the sky, perhaps a few thousand feet above the roof of the club, about 80 degrees above the horizon. I then looked around to see if others had seen the object, and noticed that several other patrons were already staring skyward. We began to ask each other if we were seeing the same thing, and if we had any idea what it was.
My initial reaction was that I was seeing some sort of balloon suspended in the sky with a light shining on it. However, I quickly realized that the light was being emitted from the object itself. I felt very strange as I stared upwards in disbelief along with several others. The orange orb appeared to be changing its shape. Its movements during this time are hard to describe, but seemed to be pulsing.
The nightclub featured many patrons with glow sticks and other flashing lights. A DJ was playing electronic music from the roof terrace. I began pointing at the object with two glow sticks to help others see what I was talking about. At this…

summary: Flame- like light moving across sky at helicopter speed but making no sound
description: We had earlier seen a strange 7 light changing formation and then as we left our friends' house 3 hours later we couldn't believe it when there was a red light going across the sky. To be precise it was more of a flame with red, orange and yellow just like a flame, flickering but not going out. We at first thought it might be a helicopter but it made no sound and moved at the speed of a helicopter, but not like any that we have ever seen. We have never seen any odd things in the night sky so tonight has been disturbing. It moved out of sight behind trees.

summary: We saw 20 to 30 fireballs floating or gliding higher and then slowly flickering out.
description:
My husband and my sister and I just came back from playing miniature golf and were driving along the road. My sister saw what she thought were red stars and asked what they were. My husband and I both said they were just towers, as we were near the airport. But then they started to move and get closer and we knew they were not towers.
Every few seconds more would float up until there were about 20 to 30 in the sky. We pulled over into a nearby plaza to get a better look and try to get some pictures.
